Absolute Masterpiece of Co-Op Gaming! (10/10)

Hands down one of the best co-op narrative experiences ever made. From the intense prison break mechanics to the seamless split-screen storytelling, Josef Fares and Hazelight cooked up something truly magical here.

The character development, the suspense, the mini-games, and THAT ENDING... absolute emotional damage! Me and my buddy went into this expecting a simple action game, but we came out traumatized.

If you have a reliable co-op partner, DO NOT SLEEP ON THIS GAME. 100% recommended!

This game does not run on RTX 50 series graphic cards - current gen hardware. It immediately crashes upon start up. Rather then fix the problem themselves, the Devs would rather blame Nvidia's drivers and have you resort to a community fix to fix the problem.

I was able to play it on a Steam Deck and the game content is fine. However, most gamers may not have access to a secondary device to play a game. The Devs show no interest in fixing the problem so I have to give it a negative review.
